name: Russian
tagline: Hear hard and soft consonants and contrasting word beginnings.

contrasts.label: Лук or люк?
contrasts.description: A soft consonant includes a tongue movement toward the hard palate. It is not simply an extra separate y syllable. The target consonant can occur at either end of a word.

l1Notes.note: English does not use this hard/soft opposition in the same systematic way. Learn it by the full recorded contrast, not spelling alone.

pairs.note: Мат has several meanings, including profanity as a category; the starter gloss here is checkmate/mat.
Broad phonemic transcription. The unstressed second vowel is reduced in actual speech.
